cues.text: Human imagination. Adaptive intelligence. Quesar by MLAI introduces assistant workflows, memory systems and developer tools with inspectable sources.
Three roles. One conversation. Abbey is a human-facing companion contract. Aviva is a direct expert mode. Abi coordinates intent, risk, context and response style.
Memory. Keep its provenance. WDBX local Rust storage and retrieval components preserve durable records, vectors and causal history.
Developers. Start with source. Explore the ABI Rust framework, local CLI and MCP contracts. Follow setup and verification guidance before connecting tools or memory.
Two names. Two distinct scopes. Quesar is the MLAI website and broader direction. Quasar is the separately configured local website builder service.
A new site. Begin with a prompt. The local service copies a Next.js template into its sites directory and runs a Claude generation job using that machine’s Anthropic credentials.
Preview. A separate opening. Preview launch obtains a ticket and checks the returned target against the configured service before opening it.
Build thoughtfully. quesar.cloud Explore the architecture. Follow the source. Define the evidence your project needs. Quesar by MLAI.
